title: Reiwa no Dara-san

thread.title: Dara-san of Reiwa • Reiwa no Dara-san - Episode 7 discussion

opinions.point: Several commenters enjoyed the episode’s blend of dark atmosphere with sudden comedy and found the tonal shifts characteristic of the series.
The community generally liked the character humor, especially the reactions among Dara-san, the children, and the family members.
Multiple commenters appreciated the emotional weight and warmth of the episode’s character-focused material.
Commenters were engaged by the expanding lore and made many theories, but some uncertainty remains about how the backstory and mythology will be paced through the cour.
Viewers noticed and enjoyed the episode’s detailed visual and audio presentation, including changes to the ending sequence and playful sound design.
